page.layout: One printed page (page 103), one column of running text. Right margin has faint marginal fragments at the level of the last lines, mostly illegible. No headings. Catchword "plenus" and signature "g 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: mo omnium studio ac alacritate absol-vit, absolutumque velut arcem & præsi-dium perpetuum contra Lacones Mef-feniis, acerbissimis & irreconciliabilibus eorum inimicis, tradidit: & simul alia quoque per regionem oppida & castella quantâ poterat maturatione commu-nivit. Hoc modo alterâ velut manu La-cedæmoniis abscissa, & perpetuo hoste iis apposito, magnaque apud omnes in Peloponneso socios, Argivos, Eleos, Ar-cades, quibus invisa & formidolosa La-conum potentia erat, inità gratiâ, inter omnium gratulationem & applausus cum victore exercitu domum rediit.

Sed gloria pupugit æmulos ejus: conflataque in eum & collegas actio violatæ legis & discrimen capitis intentatum, judicio constituto. Verum ipse, ut convenerat, excusatis collegis crimen suum esse confessus, nec ullâ defensione aut deprecatione usus, ad supplicium judicibus se obtulit. Hoc solum petiit ob merita priora, ut elogium sepulchro suo inscriberetur sibi gloriosum [illegible, ~3 letters], patriæ ignominiosum, complexum veram sumpti de se supplicii causam. Atque hæc omnia intrepidè. Corona circumstans admirata, judices attoniti, & ne calce[illegible, ~6 letters]lis quidem postulatis è tribunali digressi, actores & æmuli confusi, ipse gloria

page.notes: Printed page 103 with running head "REIP. THEBANORVM." at top, page number 103 at top right. Signature "g 4" at the foot left, catchword "plenus" at the foot right. Right margin: faint, partly illegible marginal fragments beside "gloriosum" and "calce" and below the last lines; they are not legible enough to read and are marked as such. Left margin shows only show-through/stains, not transcribed. Some marks near the ends of lines in the right margin look like Greek or printer's marks; not legible enough to copy. Word "gloriosum" and "calce" carry small reference marks that are not clearly legible; the notes are marked as illegible rather than guessed. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
